description: Add a standing rule to the workspace library. Call list_workspace_guidelines first so you do not add a near-duplicate. Attach it to the projects it applies to with `project_ids` here or `set_project_guideline` later, or set `apply_to_design_reviews` so every design review in the workspace is held to it, including the Slack and Linear ones that have no project. Codify a standard here once rather than repeating it in each checklist.

apply_to_design_reviews.description: Hold every design review in the workspace to this rule, including reviews with no project. Defaults to false.

category.description: What kind of rule this is: design_system, tone_of_voice, brand, content (labels, terminology, formatting), accessibility, compliance, security, performance, or knowledge (anything else an actor should know).

content.description: The rule itself, written so someone can observe whether the product holds to it, e.g. "Primary buttons use sentence case." Trimmed and capped at 4000 characters.

project_ids.description: Project UUIDs (from list_projects) to attach the new rule to straight away. Projects outside this workspace are reported in `attach_failed`. When omitted, the rule sits in the library unattached.

title.description: Short name for the rule, capped at 160 characters, e.g. "Sentence-case buttons". Derived from the leading words of content when omitted.

workspace_id.description: Workspace UUID, from list_workspaces. Every read and write is scoped to it.

name: add_workspace_guideline

attach_failed.description: Project UUIDs that could not be attached. The rule is saved either way; retry these with set_project_guideline.

attached_to.description: Project UUIDs the rule was attached to.

enabled.description: The library switch: false retires the rule everywhere.

id.description: Library guideline UUID, the guideline_id other tools take.

title: Add workspace guideline
